The sales report now shows totals like `0.30` instead of `0.30000000000000004`, and the fix is committed as `50ce4a5`.

The report is `SalesReport` in `src/orders-api/sales_report.py`. It summed float prices directly, which causes the drift. It now sums in `Decimal` and formats each total to two decimal places.

- **`quarterly_export.py` has the same bug.** It sums prices as floats on line 11, and the export would show the same artifacts. I left it alone since you asked about the big report. I can fix it the same way if you want.
